name: Sailab Banik
headline: Software Engineer II at ZF Group, building LLM document intelligence in production.
statement: Three years building production software at ZF Group, the last two on LLM document systems: an internal platform adopted by 20+ business teams that cut manual review by 60%, and a proof of concept that extracts data from scanned engineering drawings at 99% accuracy. Python, FastAPI and React, owned from requirements to deployment.
colophon: built with Next.js · deployed on Vercel
